reason: A notebook keeps what was typed just before its page goes away (a reload or a closed tab within the save's half second): the edited cells' text kept in localStorage on pagehide and put back, merged, when the notebook is attached again (web/notebook/notebook.js); the notebook engine bundle and the CLI, which embeds the page, carry it.
